text: Dennis To, Project Manager, Capital Projects Design and Delivery, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, and Krista Clark, Project Architect, Senior Associate, MJMA will present the accessibility features of the new John Innes Community Recreation Centre at Moss Park at the corner of Shuter and Sherbourne Street. MJMA the architect of the project will be guiding through the designs in the building and how the Toronto Accessibility Design Guidelines are being implemented to the project.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
